item.title: Rallying Cry – June 21, 2026
item.description: From Syria freeing activist Hassan Akkad to *Toy Story 5* smashing box office records, US-Iran talks resuming, and French youth proving their literary prowess, today’s news is full of wins—plus some adorable animal dads to celebrate Father’s Day!
